description: Set properties marked writable by dwg.describe_type on one existing entity. The change affects only the opened in-memory document and is discarded on close; this tool does not write the source file.

handle.description: Handle of the entity to update.

properties.description: Property names and values accepted for the entity's type. Discover writable properties with dwg.describe_type.

select.description: Optional properties to return after the update.

name: dwg.set_entity_properties
